column1: # The shortage of one label set and the distribution of the order over servers (P/04 Н3 «нехватка(), заказать()»; ADR-0084 and addenda (1)–(3)).
# Form — README alongside. Stage A (A6): the expectations are derived from the norms.

column4: note
one unit has no place: one process on the only candidate
an ordered process that has not come up covers the shortage: no increment (Р2)
in flight is subtracted from the increment by groups too (cammeta-go М10-04 № 5)
the free capacity of suitable live ones is subtracted from the weight of the waiting ones
per — the smallest positive capacity of a suitable live one; a zero one does not count
neither a positive capacity nor a positive default — no order, withheld
capacity not named — per from capacity.default
equal load — by name; the share is not more than room − in flight
candidates — by live + in flight, the smaller first
not candidates: no base, want 99, drain, «did not bring up», room 0; the remainder is not distributed
want not above 99
in flight occupies the server's room
the common free: the empty set first takes 3 of 4 (up to its need), gpu — the remainder 1 (№ 7, min)
the common capacity in flight: the set a is first by the canonical notation and takes it up to its need, b orders its own
the common room 1: a takes it, b has no candidate — withheld
the canonical notation — labels in ascending order, comma-separated: «a,z» before «b» and takes the only free one

live > want: in flight 0, the only unit of room is taken by the empty set (the first by the canonical notation), a has no candidate — withheld 5; room is spent by one set once (reconciliation М10/3–5, V3)
the base is dead: ordered live 0, number 2 in flight — in_flight 1 and covers the shortage; srv-a not a candidate (no_base) (Р13′, analysis of review of stage A 3–5, № 6)
in flight 3, the set needs 1: in_flight — how much the set took, min(Σ in flight, processes) (Р18)
in flight by heartbeats 0, but the door does not yet see the lock of number 2: free(srv-a) = 1 − |{2} ∖ {}| = 0 — not a candidate (Р14′)
the door has no live.<sub>: the server is not a candidate, although srv-a is earlier by name (Р14′)
live.<sub> — numbers, not a count: the lock of number 2 is not seen, free = 2 − |{2, 3} ∖ {3}| = 1, share 1 (Р14′)
distinct, the place from the heartbeat: the increment per pass — one trial process, the remainder withheld with no free shelf (Р16′, Р16‴; analysis of review of stage B 6–7, № 45)
on the only server a live one without a place: no candidate, all that is needed — withheld (Р16‴; analysis of review of stage B 6–7, № 45)
a delayed start: the trial is ordered and has not come up — the server is not a candidate, want does not grow above 2, however many passes go by (ADR-0084 addendum (5) Р16‴)
a named 0 is not replaced by default and does not enter per; an unnamed one — default 8 (Р19′)
a mix: per — the smallest over all suitable live ones, named or default (Р19)
a set without a computable per — an element of the same fields, zeros and why (Р20)
a label set is a set: a repeat collapses, labels in ascending order (Р21)
two sets with one canonical notation — input out of form (Р22)
want outside 1…99 — input out of form (Р22)
in live.<sub> only numbers 2…99 without repeats — input out of form (Р22)
a hole in the numbers: 1 and 4 alive with want 3 — in flight the numbers 2 and 3, not «3 − 1 − 1» (Р13′, ADR-0084 addendum (4) Р26)
a trial without a place on srv-a does not stop growth on srv-b: srv-a is not a candidate, although less loaded (Р16‴; analysis of review of stage B 6–7, № 45)
numbers not of live items — input out of form (Р22)
a trial in flight on srv-a does not hold growth on srv-b: srv-b — a candidate, one trial per pass (ADR-0084 addendum (5) Р16‴)
